scope: AKMM Chapter 5 (pp. 129-158) and Appendix 5.A (pp. 836-837): Arrow-Debreu equilibrium of the endowment, labour and growth economies with a continuum of consumers (first-order conditions, prices, shares, existence, the firm, no arbitrage, the aggregate system and the planner), sequential equilibrium (Walras's law, prices, budgets, equivalence with Arrow-Debreu, Euler's theorem), recursive steady-state equilibria, recursive competitive equilibrium and aggregation, and overlapping-generations economies.
source: Marina Azzimonti, Per Krusell, Alisdair McKay and Toshihiko Mukoyama, Macroeconomics (draft of December 2025), Chapter 5
